Frequently Asked Questions

What is the difference between PTE Academic and PTE Core?

PTE Academic is for study and migration; PTE Core is for Canadian economic migration.

What is PTE exam structure and duration?

About 2 hours across Speaking, Writing, Reading, Listening.

How is the PTE exam scored?

Automated scoring on a 10-90 scale across communicative skills.

How long is a PTE score valid?

Two years from the test date.

How much does the PTE exam cost?

Fees vary by country; check Pearson for current pricing.
